entries.english: It can be used to fuel a lantern with 7500 turns of light, up to a maximum of 15000 turns of light.  When thrown, it is considered lit, so it does more than nominal damage (which occurs even against creatures resistant to fire).
entries.japanese: ランタンに7500ターン分の油を補給できる。燃焼時間の上限は15000ターン。投げると火がついたものとして扱われ、火炎に耐性のある生物にも通常より大きなダメージを与える。

entries.english: A filling if tooth-breaking biscuit made mostly of rye.
entries.japanese: 主にライ麦で作られた、腹持ちはよいが歯が折れそうなほど硬いビスケット。

entries.english: That tastes good.
entries.japanese: おいしい。

entries.english: Wrinkled, but sound and sweet.
entries.japanese: しわは寄っているが、傷みはなく甘い。

entries.english: That tastes good.
entries.japanese: おいしい。

entries.english: Fruit roughly chopped and sun-dried, prepared as marching rations for the rangers of Ithilien.
entries.japanese: イシリアンの野伏が行軍の糧食として用意した、粗く刻んで天日干しにした果物。

entries.english: That tastes better than nothing.
entries.japanese: 何も食べないよりはましな味だ。

entries.english: A strange fungal growth, prone to moving if not observed.  Not very tasty but quite filling.
entries.japanese: 見ていないと動き出す、奇妙な菌類。あまりおいしくはないが、腹は満たされる。

entries.english: That tastes good.
entries.japanese: おいしい。

entries.english: This nutritious but fairly bland food, called cram by the Lake-men who make it is familiar to anyone contemplating long journeys.  It is sustaining, but very uninteresting except as a chewing exercise.
entries.japanese: 作り手である湖の民がクラムと呼ぶ、栄養はあるが味気ない食料。長旅を考える者にはおなじみだ。命をつなぐには十分だが、顎の運動以外に楽しみはない。

entries.english: That tastes disgusting.
entries.japanese: ひどい味だ。

entries.english: A grey-looking piece of dried flesh of you dare not guess what creature.  You would have to be desperate to eat this.
entries.japanese: どんな生物のものか想像もしたくない、灰色がかった干し肉。よほど切羽詰まらなければ食べる気にはならない。

entries.english: That tastes good.
entries.japanese: おいしい。

entries.english: A thick slice of pork, salted to keep it from spoiling.  It is very filling.
entries.japanese: 腐らないように塩漬けにした厚切りの豚肉。腹持ちがとてもよい。

entries.english: Delicious!
entries.japanese: 実においしい！

entries.english: The Beornings are renowned as the best bakers among men, and their honey-cakes are deservedly prized.  Made of wheat flour with nuts and honey and twice baked, they will sustain you through a long march.
entries.japanese: 人間随一のパン職人として知られるベオルンの一族の蜂蜜菓子は、評判にたがわぬ逸品だ。小麦粉に木の実と蜂蜜を加えて二度焼いてあり、長い行軍を支えてくれる。

entries.english: That tastes great.
entries.japanese: すばらしい味だ。

entries.english: Food of the elves is always good; their waybread is no exception.  These thin cakes are wrapped in leaves and keep their tastiness for months.
entries.japanese: エルフの食べ物はどれもおいしく、この旅糧も例外ではない。薄い焼き菓子を葉に包んであり、何か月も風味が失われない。

entries.english: That tastes great!
entries.japanese: すばらしい味だ！

entries.english: It raises your spirits.
entries.japanese: 気分を高揚させる。

entries.english: That tastes great!  A fine vintage.
entries.japanese: すばらしい味だ！ よい年代の酒だ。

entries.english: A fine way to wash down some otherwise unappetising rations.
entries.japanese: 食欲の湧かない糧食を流し込むには、うってつけだ。

entries.english: You feel your heart warm.
entries.japanese: 胸の内が温かくなる。

entries.english: Just a little of this warm and fragrant liquor gives you fresh hope and vigour.
entries.japanese: 温かく芳しいこの酒を少し口にするだけで、希望と活力がよみがえる。

entries.english: It burns your throat.
entries.japanese: 喉が焼ける。

entries.english: This is a dirty brown color; you don't trust it.
entries.japanese: 汚れた茶色をしている。信用できない。

entries.english: Refreshing!
entries.japanese: 爽やかだ！

entries.english: This looks like pure water, but its scent reminds you of the smell of a distant wood borne from afar by a cool breeze at night.
entries.japanese: 澄んだ水に見えるが、その香りは夜の涼しい風が遠くから運んでくる森の匂いを思わせる。

entries.english: It allows you to run for your life.
entries.japanese: 命からがら逃げ出せるようになる。

entries.english: Its poison turns your skin to stone, albeit briefly.
entries.japanese: その毒は、短い間ではあるが皮膚を石に変える。

entries.english: It hastes you for a while, but then makes you slower for a while afterward.
entries.japanese: しばらく加速するが、その後はしばらく減速する。

entries.english: Your stomach heaves.
entries.japanese: 胃がむかつく。

entries.english: It makes you very hungry but otherwise healthy.
entries.japanese: 激しい空腹を覚えるが、それ以外の健康状態はよくなる。

entries.english: It makes you very stealthy for a short while.
entries.japanese: 短い間、非常に隠密に行動できるようになる。

entries.english: A short two-edged blade perfect for thrusting or throwing.
entries.japanese: 突き刺すにも投げるにも適した、短い両刃の刃物。

entries.english: A short thrusting blade with a large guard, primarily used in duels.
entries.japanese: 大きな鍔を備えた短い刺突用の刃物。主に決闘で用いられる。

entries.english: A long, thin thrusting blade, mainly used in duels.
entries.japanese: 長く細い刺突用の刃物。主に決闘で用いられる。

entries.english: A short thrusting sword.
entries.japanese: 短い刺突用の剣。

entries.english: A thicker and slightly longer dagger, the cutlass is a slashing sword.  It possesses a slight curve and only one side is sharp.
entries.japanese: 短剣より厚く、やや長い斬撃用の剣。刃はわずかに湾曲し、片側だけに刃がついている。

entries.english: A wider-bladed cousin of the shamshir, with less of a curve.
entries.japanese: シャムシールに似ているが、刃が幅広く、湾曲は小さい。

entries.english: A long sabre with an extreme curve to the blade.
entries.japanese: 刃が大きく湾曲した、長いサーベル。

entries.english: A long, straight, two-edged blade, with two hand guards projecting out from the hilt to form a perfect cross.
entries.japanese: 長く真っすぐな両刃の剣。柄から二本の鍔が張り出し、完全な十字を形作っている。

entries.english: A heavy, single-edged sword with a strong grip.
entries.japanese: しっかりした握りを備えた、重い片刃の剣。

entries.english: Also known as the hand-and-a-half blade.  A larger-than-normal straight-sided sword with two cutting edges.
entries.japanese: 片手半剣とも呼ばれる。通常より大きく、真っすぐな両側に刃がついている。

entries.english: A slightly curved long-handled slashing sword with a single-edged blade and a chisel tip.
entries.japanese: 長い柄を備えた、わずかに反りのある斬撃用の剣。片刃で、先端は鑿のような形をしている。

entries.english: A sword designed for two hands.
entries.japanese: 両手で扱うように作られた剣。

entries.english: A giant, curved blade designed to cleave the head cleanly from the body.
entries.japanese: 胴体から首をきれいに切り落とすための、巨大な湾曲した刃。

entries.english: This inconstant weapon revels in disorder, hacking and slashing your foes with bloodthirsty glee.
entries.japanese: この気まぐれな武器は混乱を喜び、血に飢えた歓喜のままに敵を切り刻む。

entries.english: A heavy whip, this thick coil is thrown from the shoulder and can knock down a large man.
entries.japanese: 太い紐を巻いた重い鞭。肩から振り下ろせば、大柄な男も打ち倒せる。

entries.english: A weighty iron ball, suspended by a chain from a sturdy oaken handle.
entries.japanese: 頑丈な樫の柄から鎖で吊り下げられた、重い鉄球。

entries.english: A sturdy wooden pole connected by a chain to a ball of steel, which often has projecting spikes.
entries.japanese: 鋼の球を鎖で頑丈な木の柄につないだ武器。球にはしばしば突起がついている。

entries.english: Two heavy bars of wood connected by a short link of chain, capable of delivering crushing blows.
entries.japanese: 二本の重い木の棒を短い鎖でつないだ武器。骨を砕く打撃を与えられる。

entries.english: Two great bars of wood connected by a massive chain, needing two hands to properly wield.
entries.japanese: 二本の大きな木の棒を太い鎖でつないだ武器。十分に扱うには両手が必要だ。

entries.english: A war club with an iron head, usually flanged or spiked.
entries.japanese: 鉄の頭を備えた戦闘用の棍棒。頭には通常、ひれ状の突起や棘がついている。

entries.english: A heavy war club topped with a mass of lead-filled steel, capable of landing crushing blows.
entries.japanese: 鉛を詰めた鋼の頭を備えた、重い戦闘用の棍棒。破砕力のある打撃を与えられる。

entries.english: Six feet of oak which can be wielded in both hands to give a drubbing or block one.
entries.japanese: 長さ六フィートの樫の棒。両手で振るって相手を打ち据えたり、打撃を受け止めたりできる。

entries.english: A short-handled iron hammer that can strike hard when thrown.
entries.japanese: 短い柄の鉄槌。投げても強い打撃を与えられる。

entries.english: A mallet with a tapered head and a long handle.
entries.japanese: 先細りの頭と長い柄を備えた槌。

entries.english: A long-handled hammer with a heavy head.
entries.japanese: 重い頭を備えた、長い柄の槌。

entries.english: A mighty hammer with a massive head designed to crush and stun.
entries.japanese: 巨大な頭で敵を砕き、朦朧とさせるための強力な槌。

entries.english: A giant's weapon, enchanted with shattering power that breaks bones, bodies, and spirit.
entries.japanese: 骨も肉体も精神も打ち砕く力を魔法で与えられた、巨人の武器。

entries.english: The basic polearm, with a double-edged knife mounted on a light shaft.  This weapon can be thrown effectively.
entries.japanese: 軽い柄に両刃の短い刃を取り付けた、基本的な長柄武器。投げても有効だ。

entries.english: A more robust version of the basic polearm, with a double-edged knife mounted on a sturdy shaft.  It cannot be thrown effectively, but offers some protection to the wielder.
entries.japanese: 頑丈な柄に両刃の短い刃を取り付けた、基本的な長柄武器を強化したもの。投擲には向かないが、使い手をある程度守ってくれる。

entries.english: A three-pronged spear, originally for catching fish.
entries.japanese: もとは魚を捕るために使われた、三つ又の槍。

entries.english: The most successful of the polearms, the halberd has a long haft mounted with a heavy axe blade and opposing spike, and topped by a thrusting spine.
entries.japanese: 長柄武器の傑作。長い柄に重い斧刃と反対向きの突起を備え、先端には刺突用の穂先がついている。

entries.english: A fifteen foot spear, requiring two hands to wield, principally used in infantry formations.
entries.japanese: 両手で扱う長さ十五フィートの槍。主に歩兵の隊列で使われる。

entries.english: A short-handled hatchet, balanced for throwing.  A classic skirmisher's weapon.
entries.japanese: 投げやすいように釣り合いを取った、短い柄の手斧。散兵の伝統的な武器。

entries.english: A narrow axe head opposed by a crow's beak for penetrating armour.
entries.japanese: 細い斧刃の反対側に、鎧を貫くための烏のくちばし状の突起がついている。

entries.english: A simple, single-bladed war axe capable of chopping though limbs or armour.
entries.japanese: 手足や鎧を断ち切ることのできる、単純な片刃の戦斧。

entries.english: A double-bladed axe.  Very popular among Dwarves.
entries.japanese: 両刃の斧。ドワーフにとても人気がある。

entries.english: A long shaft with a long narrow blade.
entries.japanese: 長い柄に、長く細い刃を取り付けた武器。

entries.english: An enormous two-handed battle axe, carried by Dwarven champions, who compete to see who can cleave the most orc heads.
entries.japanese: ドワーフの勇士が携える巨大な両手斧。勇士たちは、誰が最も多くのオークの首を刎ねられるか競い合う。

entries.english: The long crescent blade stands out from the handle of this polearm, and it is swung with two hands to harvest grain or blood.
entries.japanese: 柄から長い三日月形の刃が張り出す長柄武器。両手で振るい、穀物や血を刈り取る。

entries.english: A reinforced wooden pole eight feet long, topped by a massive knife blade that can be used to thrust or chop.
entries.japanese: 長さ八フィートの補強された木の柄に、大きな刃を取り付けた武器。突くことも切ることもできる。

entries.english: A massive, tapered spear used primarily from horseback.
entries.japanese: 主に馬上で使う、巨大で先細りの槍。

entries.english: A reaper's weapon, the long blade almost hums in anticipation of the blood it will spill.
entries.japanese: 死神の武器。長い刃は、流される血を待ち望んで低くうなっているかのようだ。

entries.english: A long pole with a three- or four-pronged head balanced by a long spike.
entries.japanese: 三つまたは四つの突起を持つ頭と、釣り合いを取るための長い棘を備えた長柄武器。

entries.english: A loop of leather and cords able to hurl stones or shot with tremendous velocity.
entries.japanese: 革と紐で作られた輪。石や弾を猛烈な速さで投げ放てる。

entries.english: The traditional hunter's weapon, this light bow is easily drawn.
entries.japanese: 狩人の伝統的な武器。軽く、容易に弦を引ける。

entries.english: As tall as a man, the longbow can drive an arrow through the heaviest armour.
entries.japanese: 人間の背丈ほどの長弓。最も重厚な鎧にも矢を貫通させられる。

entries.english: A mechanical bow made of wood, it is cocked to augment the strength of its wielder.
entries.japanese: 木製の機械式の弓。弦を引いて固定することで、使い手の力を補う。

entries.english: This arbalest is so powerful it has to be reinforced with metal and requires a crank to be cocked.
entries.japanese: 非常に強力な弩。金属による補強が必要で、弦を引くには巻き上げ機を使う。

entries.english: It can be shot with a bow.
entries.japanese: 弓で射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a bow.
entries.japanese: 弓で射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a bow.
entries.japanese: 弓で射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a crossbow.
entries.japanese: クロスボウで射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a crossbow.
entries.japanese: クロスボウで射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a crossbow.
entries.japanese: クロスボウで射ることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
entries.japanese: 投石器で放つか、手で投げることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
entries.japanese: 投石器で放つか、手で投げることができる。

entries.english: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
entries.japanese: 投石器で放つか、手で投げることができる。

entries.english: A compact and sturdy spade.
entries.japanese: 小型で頑丈な鋤。

entries.english: A heavy mining tool with a long, slightly curved head that tapers to chisel points on both ends.
entries.japanese: 重い採掘道具。長くわずかに曲がった頭の両端が、鑿状に細くなっている。

entries.english: A digging tool with a broad horizontal blade balanced by a smaller vertical blade.  Used as a weapon of war by dwarves.
entries.japanese: 幅広い横刃と、小さな縦刃を備えた掘削道具。ドワーフは戦いの武器としても使う。

entries.english: A set of open-topped footgear with soft calfskin lacings and a sturdy cured leather base.
entries.japanese: 柔らかな仔牛の革紐と、丈夫になめした革底で作られた、足の甲が開いた履物。

entries.english: These are calf-high boots of flexible leather, laced from heel to calf.
entries.japanese: しなやかな革で作られた脹脛丈のブーツ。踵から脹脛まで紐で締める。

entries.english: A set of sturdy leather boots strengthened with iron that will last many weary miles.
entries.japanese: 鉄で補強された丈夫な革のブーツ。疲れる長旅にも耐える。

entries.english: A set of double-lined leather boots, with toes and heels reinforced with steel.
entries.japanese: 革を二重に張り、爪先と踵を鋼で補強したブーツ。

entries.english: The enduring dwarves make the finest footgear known, and they march in it for endless miles without wearying.
entries.japanese: 忍耐強いドワーフは、知られている限り最上の履物を作る。それを履き、果てしない道のりを疲れもせず歩く。

entries.english: Fine quality elvish slippers, hard-wearing but apparently weightless.
entries.japanese: 上質なエルフの室内履き。丈夫なのに、重さがないように感じられる。

entries.english: A padded skullcap of boiled leather.
entries.japanese: 煮固めた革に詰め物をした頭蓋帽。

entries.english: A pot-helm of steel that protects the skull.
entries.japanese: 頭蓋骨を守る、鍋形の鋼の兜。

entries.english: A mighty helmet of heavy iron, completely enclosing the head.
entries.japanese: 頭全体を覆う、重い鉄の頑丈な兜。

entries.english: This great helm covers the head and shoulders with plates of steel and a curtain of mail.
entries.japanese: 鋼板と鎖帷子の垂れで、頭と肩を覆う大兜。

entries.english: A plain band of iron, crowned with iron spikes.  It is a tyrant's symbol.
entries.japanese: 鉄の棘を冠した、飾り気のない鉄の輪。暴君の象徴だ。

entries.english: An elegant golden circlet, with slender spines thrusting upward.  It looks like it should be resting over the brow of a king.
entries.japanese: 細い突起が上へ伸びる、優雅な金の冠。王の額に載せられるべきものに見える。

entries.english: An elaboratedly decorated crown of massive gold, studded with a rainbow of gems and jewels; worthy of a High King.
entries.japanese: 重厚な金に精巧な装飾を施し、虹のような宝石を散りばめた冠。上王にふさわしい。

entries.english: A practical garment of thick wool or velvet, draping from neck to heels.
entries.japanese: 厚い毛織物やビロードで作られた実用的な衣服。首から踵までを覆う。

entries.english: A cuirass of pliable leather, with a thicker leather jack.
entries.japanese: しなやかな革の胸当てと、より厚い革の上衣。

entries.english: A cuirass of pliable leather studded with metal rivets.
entries.japanese: 金属の鋲を打ち込んだ、しなやかな革の胸当て。

entries.english: A boiled leather cuirass and shoulder plates.
entries.japanese: 煮固めた革で作られた胸当てと肩当て。

entries.english: A tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather.
entries.japanese: 硬化させた革の厚い鱗を重ねて縫い付けた、上衣と裾。

entries.english: A heavy shirt of overlapping steel scales backed by leather, with matching skirt and sleeves.
entries.japanese: 革の上に鋼の鱗を重ねた重い鎧。揃いの裾と袖がついている。

entries.english: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, well padded with leather.
entries.japanese: つなぎ合わせた鋼の輪で作られた胴鎧、脚甲、袖。革の詰め物で十分に裏打ちされている。

entries.english: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain, all over a layer of heavy padding.
entries.japanese: 鋼の輪で作られた胴鎧、脚甲、袖。急所には鎖帷子を二重に重ね、全体を厚い詰め物で裏打ちしている。

entries.english: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, reinforced around the shoulders with segmented plates of steel, all over a layer of heavy padding.
entries.japanese: 鋼の輪で作られた胴鎧、脚甲、袖。肩の周囲を分割された鋼板で補強し、全体を厚い詰め物で裏打ちしている。

entries.english: A stiff suit of armour composed of small metal plates sewn to an inner layer of heavy canvas, and covered with a second layer of cloth.
entries.japanese: 厚い帆布の内張りに小さな金属板を縫い付け、その上をさらに布で覆った、硬い鎧。

entries.english: A steel corselet and vambraces over a skirt and leggings of chain.
entries.japanese: 鎖帷子の裾と脚甲の上に、鋼の胸当てと前腕当てを備えた鎧。

entries.english: This unusual armour is a surprisingly light suit of laced and overlapping metal plates.
entries.japanese: 紐で結んだ金属板を重ね合わせた、珍しい鎧。驚くほど軽い。

entries.english: A full suit of carefully fitted plates, with hinged joints backed by chain, and light padding underneath.
entries.japanese: 体に合わせて丁寧に整えた鋼板の全身鎧。関節には蝶番と鎖帷子を用い、内側に薄い詰め物がある。

entries.english: A full suit of finely fitted metal armour consisting of steel plates with reinforced ridging.
entries.japanese: 細かく体に合わせた金属製の全身鎧。鋼板の隆起部を補強している。

entries.english: This wondrous suit of fine-linked chain shimmers as though of pure silver.
entries.japanese: 純銀のようにきらめく、細かな鎖をつないだ見事な鎧。

entries.english: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend.  It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it.
entries.japanese: 伝説のドワーフ鍛冶が遠い昔に鍛えた、真銀のきらめく鎧。見つめると、純白の光を放つ。

entries.english: An exquisite suit of nearly impenetrable adamantite.
entries.japanese: ほとんど貫くことのできないアダマンタイトの、精巧な鎧。

entries.english: A traveller's sturdy outer garment.
entries.japanese: 旅人の丈夫な外套。

entries.english: A heavy cloak made from fur and lined with leather; a luxury.
entries.japanese: 毛皮で作られ、革の裏地を備えた重い外套。贅沢な品だ。

entries.english: A mantle made of curious silken material by the Galadrim that wondrously takes on the hues and shapes of its surroundings.
entries.japanese: ガラドリムが不思議な絹状の素材で作った外套。周囲の色や形に見事に溶け込む。

entries.english: This unearthly, completely transparent body mantle folds and drapes in iridescent patterns around you.  It weighs absolutely nothing.
entries.japanese: この世ならぬ、完全に透き通った外套。虹色の模様を折り重ねて体を包む。重さはまったくない。

entries.english: Leather hand protection, with an open palm for gripping weapons.
entries.japanese: 武器を握るために手のひらを開けた、革製の手の防具。

entries.english: A set of gloves that completely covers the hand and wrist in steel plating.
entries.japanese: 手と手首を鋼板で完全に覆う籠手。

entries.english: A set of gauntlets wrought of light, shining mithril.
entries.japanese: 軽く輝くミスリルで作られた籠手。

entries.english: An ancient battle glove designed for hand-to-hand fighting.  Its layered leather thongs are enhanced for combat by bloody-looking spikes.
entries.japanese: 徒手格闘のための古い戦闘用手袋。重ねた革紐に血塗られたような棘をつけ、戦闘力を高めている。

entries.english: Highly protective gloves designed for an alchemist's elemental magics.
entries.japanese: 錬金術師の元素魔法に備え、非常に高い防護力を持たせた手袋。

entries.english: A light circular frame of wood surrounding fine-grained wickerwork.
entries.japanese: 緻密に編んだ枝を、軽い丸い木枠で囲んだ盾。

entries.english: A round shield of wood reinforced with metal rims and central disk.
entries.japanese: 金属の縁と中央の円盤で補強した、木製の丸盾。

entries.english: A large oval shield made of layered wooden strips with a thick leather covering.
entries.japanese: 木の細板を重ね、厚い革で覆った大きな楕円形の盾。

entries.english: An oval shield of wood covered by leather and rimmed with metal.  A large iron shield boss offers excellent hand protection.
entries.japanese: 革で覆い、金属で縁取った木製の楕円形の盾。大きな鉄の中央突起が手をしっかり守る。

entries.english: A kite-shaped shield with rounded corners that covers the wearer from chest to toe, emblazoned with heraldic symbols.
entries.japanese: 丸みのある角を持つ凧形の盾。胸から爪先までを覆い、紋章が描かれている。

entries.english: A shield of purest white, made of mithril.
entries.japanese: ミスリルで作られた、純白の盾。

entries.english: It boosts your to-dam value.
entries.japanese: ダメージ修正を高める。

entries.english: It boosts your to-hit value.
entries.japanese: 命中修正を高める。

entries.english: It boosts your to-hit and to-dam values.
entries.japanese: 命中修正とダメージ修正を高める。

entries.english: There is a high pitched humming noise.
entries.japanese: 甲高いうなりが響く。

entries.english: You hear a low-pitched whistling sound.
entries.japanese: 低い笛のような音が聞こえる。

entries.english: You feel life flow through your body!
entries.japanese: 生命が体を巡るのを感じる！

entries.english: The potion makes you queasy.
entries.japanese: 薬を飲んで吐き気がする。

entries.english: A line of shimmering blue light appears.
entries.japanese: 青くきらめく光の筋が現れる。

entries.english: A line of shimmering blue light appears.
entries.japanese: 青くきらめく光の筋が現れる。

entries.english: A suit of utterly black scales, against which no metal or wood can rest.
entries.japanese: 何ものも触れられぬほど黒く染まった鱗の鎧。金属も木も、その上に留まれない。

entries.english: A suit of scales as blue as sapphires, emitting eerie sparks and coronas as you move about in it.
entries.japanese: サファイアのように青い鱗の鎧。身動きするたびに、不気味な火花と光冠を放つ。

entries.english: A suit of scales, coldly gleaming in frosty white.  A shiver runs down through your spine even as you look at it.
entries.japanese: 霜のように白く、冷たく輝く鱗の鎧。見るだけで背筋に震えが走る。

entries.english: A suit of scales, with all the reds of every fire ever lit.  The scar tissue from an old burn aches as you put this armour on.
entries.japanese: これまで燃えたあらゆる炎の赤を宿す、鱗の鎧。身につけると、古い火傷の跡が痛む。

entries.english: A suit of scales, glistening in sickly green, out from which falls the skeleton of a rat who touched it and died in agony.
entries.japanese: 病的な緑色に輝く鱗の鎧。触れて苦悶のうちに死んだ鼠の骨が、そこから落ちてくる。

entries.english: A suit of scales that throbs with angry energies; it takes all your energy to master the Elements fighting an endless war trapped inside.
entries.japanese: 怒れる力が脈打つ鱗の鎧。内部で果てしなく争う元素を制御するには、すべての力を尽くさなければならない。

entries.english: A suit of scales shining like a beacon of Light even as it greedily sucks the energy away from everything that glows into Dark insatiate.
entries.japanese: 光の標のように輝く鱗の鎧。同時に、輝くすべてのものから力を貪欲に吸い取り、飽くことのない闇へと変える。

entries.english: A suit of scales in stern blue and silver.  You feel the slightest tremor as you touch it, like massed trumpets heard and cyclones felt from afar.
entries.japanese: 厳かな青と銀の鱗の鎧。触れると、遠くの大群の喇叭や旋風を感じるような、ごく小さな震動を覚える。

entries.english: A suit of scales in mirror-like gold.  You hear nothing unusual as you wear this armour, yet your ears ache as though in the midst of a cacophony.
entries.japanese: 鏡のような金色の鱗の鎧。身につけても異音は聞こえないが、不協和音のただ中にいるかのように耳が痛む。

entries.english: A suit of scales that ripples and twists through every color and shape imaginable as you stare in fascination.
entries.japanese: 見つめる者を魅了し、想像しうるあらゆる色と形へと波打ち、ねじれる鱗の鎧。

entries.english: A suit of scales.  Featureless grey to casual inspection, yet a closer look reveals patterns within patterns of iridescence that throb with leashed energies bound as though by chains of adamant.
entries.japanese: 一見すると何の変哲もない灰色の鱗の鎧。近くで見ると、虹色の模様の中にさらに模様があり、金剛の鎖で束縛されたような力が脈打っている。

entries.english: A suit with scales of every color, surrounded in a nimbus of perfectly untrammelled yet inextricably intermingled and utterly mastered powers elemental and ethereal.
entries.japanese: あらゆる色の鱗を備えた鎧。元素と霊的な力が、自由でありながら分かちがたく交わり、完全な支配のもとに光輪を形作っている。

entries.english: Forged by Telchar, greatest of Dwarven smiths, and used by Beren to gouge a Silmaril out of Morgoth's crown, this long chopping dagger slices through ordinary metal as easily as its name, "Iron Cleaver", suggests.

entries.english: Instead of a blade, a flame seems to emerge from this dagger's hilt.
entries.japanese: この短剣の柄からは、刃ではなく炎が伸びているかのようだ。

entries.english: In this dagger is bound the very force of lightning.

entries.english: A large stiletto dagger that glistens with odorless poison, to which the wearer seems oddly immune.

entries.english: A frosty dagger wreathed in a nimbus of ice with a hilt of elk horn and an edge to wound the wind.
entries.japanese: 氷の光輪をまとった冷たい短剣。大鹿の角の柄と、風さえ傷つける刃を持つ。

entries.english: Azaghâl, Dwarf-king of Belegost, fell before Glaurung in the Battle of Unnumbered Tears.  With his final breath, Azaghâl plunged this blade into Glaurung's belly with such a blow that the Father of Dragons fled the field with all his kin, and was at first believed to be mortally wounded.
entries.japanese: ベレゴストのドワーフ王アザガールは、涙尽きざる合戦でグラウルングの前に倒れた。息を引き取る直前、アザガールはこの刃をグラウルングの腹へ深々と突き刺した。竜の父は一族を連れて戦場から逃げ去り、初めは致命傷を負ったと思われた。

entries.english: A short thrusting blade with a large guard worn by the eldest son of Fëanor, Maedhros the Tall, who lost his right hand while escaping from Angband.
entries.japanese: 大きな鍔を持つ、短い刺突用の刃。アングバンドから逃れる際に右手を失ったフェアノールの長子、長身のマエズロスが身につけていた。

entries.english: A slender, tapered needle of ice that coldly grips its impaled prey.
entries.japanese: 突き刺した獲物を冷たく捕らえる、細く先細りの氷の針。

entries.english: An heirloom of the dauntless Lords of Rhûn far to the east, and a name of dismay to creatures natural and unnatural.
entries.japanese: 遥か東のルーンの勇敢な領主たちに伝わる宝。自然の生物にも不自然な存在にも恐れられる名を持つ。

entries.english: "I will give you a name, and I shall call you Sting."  The perfect size for Bilbo, and stamped forever by the courage he found in Mirkwood, this sturdy little blade grants the wearer combat prowess and survival abilities he did not know he had.
entries.japanese: 『おまえに名前をつけよう。つらぬき丸と呼ぼう。』ビルボにぴったりの大きさで、闇の森で見いだした彼の勇気が永遠に刻まれた、丈夫な小さな刃。持ち主に、自分でも知らなかった戦闘と生存の力を授ける。

entries.english: A stubby blade worn by Beren, whose horn sounded of old in the glades of Brethil.
entries.japanese: ベレンが身につけた短い刃。かつてブレシルの林間には彼の角笛が響いた。

entries.english: Famed sea-defender of Lebennin.  A short, slightly curved chopping blade with a perfect edge shining cleanly in the sun, an object of hate to the men of Umbar who met it in combat.
entries.japanese: レベンニンの名高い海の守り手。短く少し湾曲した切断用の刃で、完璧な刃先が陽光に澄んで輝く。戦でこの刃に出会ったウンバールの者たちに憎まれた品。

entries.english: A damascened scimitar that hefts with wondrous ease.  Famed in song as the "Sickle of Harad", and a deadly foe to the undead.
entries.japanese: 見事な模様を持ち、驚くほど軽く扱える曲刀。歌には『ハラドの鎌』として知られ、アンデッドにとって致命的な敵である。

entries.english: The weapon of Fingolfin, High King of the Noldor; it shines like a column of ice lit by light unquenchable.  Morgoth came but unwillingly to meet it of old; his lame foot will remind him of its might should he face it again.
entries.japanese: ノルドールの上級王フィンゴルフィンの武器。消えぬ光に照らされた氷の柱のように輝く。かつてモルゴスは気が進まぬままこの剣と対峙した。再び向き合えば、足の古傷がその威力を思い出させるだろう。

entries.english: The famed "Flame of the West", the Sword that was Broken and is forged again.  It glows with the essence of fire, its wearer is mighty in combat, and no creature of Sauron can withstand it.
entries.japanese: 名高い『西方の炎』。折れた剣を鍛え直したものである。火の精髄を帯びて輝き、持ち主を戦で強くする。サウロンの生き物でこれに耐えられるものはいない。

entries.english: This black blade was forged of meteoric iron by Eöl the Dark Elf.  It is imbued with the malice of its maker; as dangerous to its wielder as it is deadly to his foes.
entries.japanese: 暗闇のエルフ、エオルが隕鉄から鍛えた黒い刃。作り手の悪意が宿り、敵に致命的であるのと同じほど、使い手にも危険である。

entries.english: The "Singing Blade", whose wearer can slay Orcs and Trolls in the hidden and secret places of the earth.
entries.japanese: 『歌う刃』。持ち主は地の隠された秘密の場所でオークやトロルを討つことができる。

entries.english: The beautiful sword of Thingol, justly named "King's Ire".  It glistens icy enough to freeze the hearts of demons, and you feel supple and lightfooted as you clasp its hilt of gold and silver inlay.
entries.japanese: 『王の怒り』の名にふさわしい、シンゴルの美しい剣。デーモンの心を凍らせるほど冷たく光り、金と銀の象嵌がある柄を握ると、体がしなやかになり足が軽くなる。

entries.english: This fiery, shining blade, mate to Orcrist, earned its sobriquet "Beater" from dying orcs who dared to behold hidden Gondolin.
entries.japanese: オルクリストと対をなす、炎のように輝く刃。隠れたゴンドリンを見ようとした瀕死のオークたちが『なぐり丸』と呼んだ。

entries.english: Companion to Orcrist and Glamdring, and like them long lost, this sword is continually covered in tiny arcs of captive lightning that flash and dance eerily in the globes of light they create.
entries.japanese: オルクリストとグラムドリングの仲間で、同じく長く失われていた剣。封じられた稲妻の小さな弧が絶えず表面を覆い、生み出した光の球の中で不気味に閃き、踊る。

entries.english: This coldly gleaming blade, mate to Glamdring, is called simply "Biter" by orcs who came to know its power all too well.
entries.japanese: グラムドリングと対をなす、冷たく光る刃。その力を痛いほど知るオークたちは、ただ『かみつき丸』と呼ぶ。

entries.english: This sword has runes of power incused on its ornate hilt, and a single blood channel that gleams coldly blue as you grasp this mighty weapon of peril.
entries.japanese: 装飾された柄に力のルーンが刻まれた剣。この危険で強大な武器を握ると、一本の血溝が冷たい青で光る。

entries.english: The blade of the legendary Shieldmaiden of Rohan, who slew the foul steed of the Morgul-lord before striking down the mighty Witch-king himself, whom no mortal man could hinder.
entries.japanese: ローハンの伝説的な盾持つ乙女の刃。彼女はモルグルの王の邪悪な乗騎を討ち、さらに人間の男には阻めぬ強大な魔王自身を打ち倒した。

entries.english: An utterly perfect, cleanly chiseled sword, with an edge that effortlessly slices rock and bone, and spells to render the wearer lithe and nimble.  It is combat incarnate.
entries.japanese: 完全無欠に鍛え上げられた剣。刃は岩も骨も難なく切り、魔法は持ち主をしなやかで敏捷にする。戦闘そのものが形を得た品である。

entries.english: A giant sword once wielded by mighty Túrin, and an even greater dragonbane; for what worm could stand against the blade that bathed in Glaurung's blood?
entries.japanese: かつて強大なトゥーリンが振るった巨剣であり、さらに強力な竜殺し。グラウルングの血を浴びた刃に耐えられる竜がいるだろうか。

entries.english: Runes dark and deadly stand stark against the naked steel of this awesome weapon, and you feel a wrathful power of slaying and rending as you slowly approach.
entries.japanese: この恐るべき武器のむき出しの鋼には、暗く致命的なルーンがくっきりと浮かぶ。ゆっくり近づくと、殺し引き裂く怒りの力を感じる。

entries.english: A foul, twisted sword with blackened spines and knobs, its very name is a curse upon the lips of Elves and Men.  It is said that it will drink the very lifeblood of its wielder.
entries.japanese: 黒ずんだ棘と瘤のある、邪悪でねじれた剣。その名を口にすること自体が、エルフにも人間にも呪いとなる。使い手の生き血を飲むという。

entries.english: A giant's weapon, with a long blade tall and straight thrusting out from a massive double-pronged hilt.  On its blade are written doomspells against both the living and undead.
entries.japanese: 巨大な二又の柄から、長く高くまっすぐな刃が伸びる巨人の武器。刃には生者とアンデッドの両方を滅ぼす呪文が記されている。

entries.english: This weapon of wrath, wrought by a desperate berserker gang, dives hungrily into the yielding flesh of your enemies.  You yourself fall under the shadow of death even as you inflict wounds that will not heal.
entries.japanese: 絶望的な狂戦士の一団が作った怒りの武器。敵の柔らかな肉へ飢えたように食い込む。癒えぬ傷を与えながら、あなた自身も死の影に覆われる。

entries.english: A great crackling Balrog's whip of flame, this weapon could bring even Ungoliant to heel.
entries.japanese: 炎をはぜさせる、バルログの大鞭。この武器ならウンゴリアントさえ従わせられるだろう。

entries.english: The weapon of a mighty dwarven priest, whose shade is rumoured to haunt the halls of Angband still.
entries.japanese: 強大なドワーフの僧侶の武器。彼の亡霊は今もアングバンドの広間に出るという。

entries.english: You feel strong and firm of foot as you whip its spiked orb around and bathe it in the blood of your foes.
entries.japanese: 棘のある球を振り回して敵の血に浸すと、自分が強くなり足取りも確かになったように感じる。

entries.english: A famed battle-lord of old with a head as ruddy as embers that can yet rise up in wrath.
entries.japanese: 往時の名高い戦の王。熾火のように赤い頭は、今なお怒りに燃え上がる。

entries.english: A flail whose head befuddles those who stare as you whirl it round and becomes a fiery comet as you bring it down.
entries.japanese: 振り回すと、その頭を見つめる者を惑わせ、振り下ろすと炎の彗星になるフレイル。

entries.english: The long-lost weapon of Kzurin, Dwarven champion of ancient Belegost Runes of strength adorn its handle, and flames and sparks roar and crackle around its massive head.
entries.japanese: 古のベレゴストのドワーフの勇士クズリンが持ち、長く失われていた武器。柄には力のルーンが飾られ、巨大な頭の周りで炎と火花が轟き、はぜる。

entries.english: A great ridged mace that surrounds you with a nimbus of living lightning.  You remain utterly untouched, even as fat sparks crackle around your fingers and eyebrows.
entries.japanese: 生きた稲妻の光輪であなたを包む、稜のある大きなメイス。指や眉の周りで太い火花がはぜても、あなたはまったく傷つかない。

entries.english: Named for a fiery star and set with priceless gems bearing mystic auras of protection and thought.
entries.japanese: 燃える星にちなんだ名を持ち、守りと思考の神秘的な力を帯びた、値のつけられない宝石がはめ込まれている。

entries.english: The radiant golden staff of an Istar of legend, this wizard's companion grants keen sight and clear knowledge of many hidden things.
entries.japanese: 伝説のイスタリの、輝く黄金の杖。この魔法使いの伴侶は、鋭い視力と多くの隠されたものへの明晰な知識を授ける。

entries.english: A staff tall and sturdy, borne of old by Gandalf.  Rough-hewn runes that invoke the element of Earth stand bold upon its gnarled surface, and no creature who lives in the shadow of mountains can withstand the blows it deals.
entries.japanese: かつてガンダルフが携えた、背の高い頑丈な杖。節くれだった表面には大地の元素を呼ぶ荒削りのルーンがくっきりと刻まれ、山の影に生きるどんな生き物も、その打撃に耐えられない。

entries.english: The wondrous hammer of Aulë, creator of the wise Dwarven lords of old.  It bears demolishing magics that no serpent or demon can withstand, and invokes the strength of mountains to ward off the tumult of the elements.
entries.japanese: 古の賢いドワーフの王たちを創ったアウレの、不思議な槌。どんな蛇もデーモンも耐えられない破壊の魔法を持ち、山の力を呼んで元素の猛威を防ぐ。

entries.english: A weapon so massive it seems beyond the strength of mortals, yet you feel the might of giants within you as you heft it.  As you grip the handle of ebony and steel, coronas of fire blaze, and mighty spells to preserve magic surge around you.  You wield the Fear of Dragons and the Despair of the Undead!
entries.japanese: あまりに巨大で人間の力では扱えそうにない武器だが、持ち上げると巨人の力が内に湧く。黒檀と鋼の柄を握ると炎の光冠が燃え立ち、魔法を守る強大な呪文が周囲に満ちる。あなたは竜の恐怖、アンデッドの絶望を振るうのだ！

entries.english: The mighty spear of Gil-galad, famed as "Snow-point" in the songs of Elves.  Against it, all the foul corruptions of Sauron dashed in vain.
entries.japanese: エルフの歌に『雪の穂先』と名高い、ギル＝ガラドの強大な槍。サウロンの邪悪な堕落したものすべてが、これにぶつかり空しく砕けた。

entries.english: The thrusting spear of wise Oromë the Vala, strong against giants of frost, and able to pierce rock or flesh with ease.
entries.japanese: 賢いヴァラ、オロメの刺突用の槍。冷気の巨人に強く、岩も肉もたやすく貫く。

entries.english: A thin spike of thrice-forged steel caps a straight silvan shaft cut from a legendary tree, and spells to break the wills of the undead and strike cold into the breasts of your enemies lay upon this perfectly balanced spear.
entries.japanese: 伝説の木から切り出したまっすぐな森の柄の先に、三度鍛えた鋼の細い穂先がある。見事に均衡の取れたこの槍には、アンデッドの意志を砕き、敵の胸に冷気を打ち込む呪文がかけられている。

entries.english: A mighty, heavy black spear, once wielded by the Lord of Darkness himself as he came to Valinor in wrath.  Its envenomed bite pierced the Two Trees with wounds that would not heal.
entries.japanese: 闇の王自身が怒りに燃えてヴァリノールへ来たとき、かつて振るった重く強大な黒い槍。その毒の一突きは二本の木を貫き、癒えぬ傷を残した。

entries.english: A massive triple-pronged spear, so great it normally requires two hands to wield, evoking the spirit of Osse who with it pierced legions of evil and undead.
entries.japanese: 通常は両手で扱うほど大きな、巨大な三又の槍。これで邪悪とアンデッドの軍勢を貫いたオッセの魂を呼び起こす。

entries.english: The awesome weapon of the Vala Ulmo, Lord of Waters.  Mightiest of all the powers of good save Manwë himself, Ulmo laughs to scorn the dread powers of the undead, and is utterly in command of the Element of water.
entries.japanese: 水の王、ヴァラのウルモの畏るべき武器。善なる力のうちマンウェ自身に次ぐ強さを持つウルモは、アンデッドの恐るべき力を嘲笑い、水の元素を完全に支配する。

entries.english: Lordly and tall did Osondir stand against the wrath of giants, and clear-eyed in barrows fell, wielding a halberd glowing ruby red.
entries.japanese: オソンディアは威厳ある長身をもって巨人の怒りに立ち向かい、邪悪な塚でも澄んだ目を保ち、ルビー色に輝くハルバードを振るった。

entries.english: Within this long two-handed spear dwell the spirits of frost giants and fire demons, who war forever, fettered by sorcerous binds.
entries.japanese: この長い両手槍には冷気の巨人と火炎のデーモンの魂が宿り、魔法の縛めに繋がれたまま永遠に争っている。

entries.english: The narrow axe head of this weapon would pierce the armour of a very Dragon, and the designs of your enemies stand naked and revealed.
entries.japanese: この武器の細い斧頭はドラゴンの鎧さえ貫き、敵の企みも隠し立てなく露わになる。

entries.english: Wielded by Húrin Thalion, last lord of Dor-Lómin at the Battle of Tears Unnumbered.  He stood alone, his friends and kinsmen dead about him, his axe smoking in the black blood of Gothmog's troll-guard.  No less than seventy times, as he slew his foes, did he utter his mighty war-cry: "Aurë entuluva!" - "Day shall come again!"
entries.japanese: 涙尽きざる合戦で、ドル＝ローミン最後の領主フーリン・サリオンが振るった斧。友と親族が周囲に倒れる中、彼は一人立ち、斧はゴスモグのトロルの護衛の黒い血を浴びて煙を上げた。敵を討ちながら七十回以上も、彼は力強い鬨の声を上げた。『アウレ・エントゥルヴァ！』――『日はまた昇る！』

entries.english: A royal heirloom of the southern coast, strong in combat against the evil creatures of earth.
entries.japanese: 南の海岸の王家に伝わる宝。大地の邪悪な生き物との戦いに強い。

entries.english: The twin blades of this weapon were forged in Belegost, and powerful forces to resist and endure lie ready for its next owner.
entries.japanese: この武器の二枚の刃はベレゴストで鍛えられた。抵抗し、耐え抜く強力な力が、次の持ち主を待っている。

entries.english: A superbly crafted double-bladed axe once borne by Ceruthain, commander of the Rangers of Arnor.
entries.japanese: かつてアルノールのレンジャーの指揮官ケルサインが携えた、見事な造りの双刃の斧。

entries.english: A massive axe with twin razor-sharp heads, so large that it usually requires two hands to wield, with spells to ward off the elements intricately engraved upon its surface in filleted gold.
entries.japanese: 剃刀のように鋭い二つの斧頭を持ち、通常は両手で扱うほど大きな斧。元素を防ぐ呪文が、金の細帯で表面に精緻に彫り込まれている。

entries.english: The twin massive axe heads of this ancient demon's dread gleam with mithril inlay telling sagas of endurance.  The powers of Khazad-dûm protect its wielder and slay all evils found underground.
entries.japanese: この古きデーモンの恐怖たる武器の二つの大きな斧頭には、忍耐の物語を描くミスリルの象嵌が輝く。カザド＝ドゥムの力が持ち主を守り、地下にいるすべての邪悪を討つ。

entries.english: The axe of Eönwë, leader of the Hosts of the West in the War of Wrath, strikes with icy wrath at the undead, disperses hosts of evil at a word, and grants Maia-like powers of body and mind.
entries.japanese: 怒りの戦いで西方の軍を率いたエオンウェの斧。氷の怒りでアンデッドを打ち、一言で邪悪の軍勢を散らし、肉体と精神にマイアのような力を授ける。

entries.english: Holding elemental powers whose struggles turn this weapon red and purest white, this shining reaper bears within it a power of going forth and returning.
entries.japanese: 元素の力が争うことで赤と純白に変わる、輝く大鎌。その内には出発と帰還の力が宿る。

entries.english: The massive cleaver that crowns this glaive glows blood-red and black; fell spells of annihilation swirl and dance as you swing death's myrmidon down.
entries.japanese: このグレイブの先端を成す巨大な刃は、血の赤と黒で光る。死の従者を振り下ろすと、滅びの邪悪な呪文が渦巻き、踊る。

entries.english: "Forth Eorlingas!"  To the field of Celebrant, Eorl the Young came beyond hope to save beleaguered Gondor, and from his lance fled massive trolls and dire wolves.
entries.japanese: 『進め、エオルの子らよ！』絶望の中、若きエオルはケレブラントの野へ駆けつけ、包囲されたゴンドールを救った。巨大なトロルや恐ろしい狼は、彼の槍から逃れた。

entries.english: Once wielded by the High Priest of Meneltarma, this great mace gleams coldly as though moonlit, and can strike equally mighty spiritual and physical blows.
entries.japanese: かつてメネルタルマの高僧が振るった大きなメイス。月光を受けたように冷たく光り、精神にも肉体にも等しく強大な打撃を与える。

entries.english: One of a pair of hunting bows once belonging to Fëanor's two youngest sons.  The bows are like and yet unlike, much as the twin brothers were.
entries.japanese: フェアノールの末の二人の息子がかつて持っていた、一対の狩猟弓の一つ。双子の兄弟と同じように、二つの弓は似ていながら違っている。

entries.english: One of a pair of hunting bows once belonging to Fëanor's two youngest sons.  The bows are like and yet unlike, much as the twin brothers were.
entries.japanese: フェアノールの末の二人の息子がかつて持っていた、一対の狩猟弓の一つ。双子の兄弟と同じように、二つの弓は似ていながら違っている。

entries.english: The great bow of Beleg Cúthalion, the most famous archer of the Elves.  Its backbone of black yew holds strings of bear sinew, and of old, only Beleg himself could draw them.
entries.japanese: エルフで最も名高い弓手、ベレグ・クサリオンの大弓。黒いイチイの本体に熊の腱の弦を張り、かつてはベレグ自身しか引けなかった。

entries.english: The great yew bow of grim-faced Bard, who shot the mightiest arrow that songs record.
entries.japanese: 歌に記される最も強大な矢を放った、厳しい顔のバルドの大きなイチイの弓。

entries.english: A crossbow that grants fiery speed to its finder, and imbues its bolts with flame unquenchable.
entries.japanese: 見いだした者に炎のような速さを授け、矢に消えぬ炎を宿すクロスボウ。

entries.english: A great brazen arbalest with arms of gleaming steel.  It shoots quarrels with mighty power for those brave enough to risk betrayal.
entries.japanese: 輝く鋼の腕を持つ、大きな真鍮のクロスボウ。裏切りの危険を冒す勇気ある者に、強大な力で矢を放つ。

entries.english: A fine dwarven pick, good for a miner, and suitable as a weapon should the wielder ever tunnel through into a foe's stronghold.
entries.japanese: 採掘者に適した、優れたドワーフのつるはし。敵の砦へ掘り抜けたときには、武器としてもふさわしい。

entries.english: A mighty Dwarven mattock, as good for hewing orc-necks as for hewing stone.  Náin, King of the Iron Hills, brought his mattock-wielding warriors to the Battle of Azanulbizar, and no Orc could withstand them, although Náin himself fell before their lord Azog.
entries.japanese: 石を掘るのと同じほど、オークの首を断つのにも優れたドワーフの大つるはし。鉄の丘の王ナインは、このつるはしを振るう戦士たちをアザヌルビザールの戦いへ率いた。ナイン自身はオークの王アゾグに倒れたが、オークに彼らを止められる者はいなかった。

entries.english: This wondrous pair of leather boots once sped Fëanor, creator of the Silmarils and the mightiest of the Eldar, to fulfill his hero's challenge and do battle for a Middle-Earth held in thrall.  "Dear-bought those songs shall be accounted, and yet shall be well-bought.  For the price could be no other."
entries.japanese: シルマリルを創ったエルダール最強の者フェアノールは、この不思議な革靴で駆け、英雄の挑戦を果たし、束縛された中つ国のために戦った。『これらの歌は高い代価で買われたとされよう。だが、それに値する買い物となろう。その代価は、ほかのものではありえなかったのだから。』

entries.english: A pair of high-laced shoes, bestowing extraordinary agility and proof against the powers of corruption and withering.
entries.japanese: 高く紐で締める一足の靴。並外れた敏捷さを授け、堕落と衰弱の力を防ぐ。

entries.english: A pair of running shoes once used by the treacherous Gríma son of Gálmód, the Wormtongue of Edoras.  They are aptly suited for a messenger, a servant, a spy... or a coward.
entries.japanese: かつてガルモドの息子、エドラスの蛇の舌グリマが使っていた運動靴。伝令、従者、密偵……あるいは臆病者によく似合う。

entries.english: Made of brown leather, covered with scuff marks and dust, still these boots possess the magic of Radagast, friend of birds and nature.
entries.japanese: 擦り傷と埃に覆われた茶色の革靴だが、今も鳥と自然の友ラダガストの魔法を宿している。

entries.english: Sturdy footwear of leather and steel as enduring as the long-suffering Dwarven king-in-exile who wore them.
entries.japanese: 革と鋼の頑丈な靴。身につけていた、苦難に耐える亡命ドワーフ王と同じほど長く耐える。

entries.english: And they hewed off Gelmir's hands and feet, and his head last, within sight of the Elves, and left him.  By ill chance there stood Gwindor of Nargothrond, the brother of Gelmir.  Now his wrath was kindled to madness, and he leapt forth on horseback, and many riders with him; and they pursued the heralds and slew them, and drove on deep into the main host.
entries.japanese: 彼らはエルフの目の前でゲルミアの両手と両足、最後に首を切り落として置き去りにした。不運にも、そこにはゲルミアの兄弟、ナルゴスロンドのグウィンドールがいた。怒りは狂気に燃え上がり、彼は多くの騎手とともに馬を駆って飛び出した。使者を追って殺し、そのまま本隊の奥深くへ突き進んだ。

entries.english: The hunting cap of King Thranduil, to whose ears come all the secrets of his forest domain.
entries.japanese: スランドゥイル王の狩猟帽。その耳には、森の領地のあらゆる秘密が届く。

entries.english: A ridged helmet made of steel and embossed with scenes of valor in fine-engraved silver.  It grants the wearer nobility and understanding.
entries.japanese: 稜のある鋼の兜。細かく彫った銀で武勇の場面が浮き彫りにされている。持ち主に気高さと理解を授ける。

entries.english: A metal cap forged by the greatest Noldorin smith of the Second Age, this helm serves equally well in battle or at the forge, and its enchantment will never be diminished.
entries.japanese: 第二紀最高のノルドールの鍛冶師が鍛えた金属の帽子。戦場でも鍛冶場でも同じように役立ち、その魔法が衰えることはない。

entries.english: The legendary Dragon-helm, forged by one of the legendary Dwarven smiths of the First Age.  The visage of mighty Glaurung forms its crest, and the mere sight of the helm, borne by Túrin Turambar, struck dread into the hearts of the servants of Morgoth.
entries.japanese: 第一紀の伝説的なドワーフの鍛冶師の一人が作った、伝説の竜の兜。強大なグラウルングの姿を前立てとし、トゥーリン・トゥランバールがかぶる姿を見ただけで、モルゴスの従僕たちは恐怖した。

entries.english: A famous forged iron helm granting extraordinary powers of mind and awareness.
entries.japanese: 精神と知覚に並外れた力を授ける、名高い鍛鉄の兜。

entries.english: A headpiece, gaudy and barbaric, that betrayed a warrior when he most needed succor.
entries.japanese: 派手で野蛮な頭具。最も救いを必要としたとき、その戦士を裏切った。

entries.english: A great helm, as steady and as distinctive as the hero of the Westdike.  Many long months was Helm Hammerhand besieged in the Hornburg, yet he strode out time and again among his foes and slew many.  Although they knew of his coming, none could stand against him.
entries.japanese: 西の堤の英雄と同じく、不動で際立った大兜。槌手王ヘルムは角笛城で長い月日の包囲に耐えながら、何度も敵の中へ踏み出して多数を討った。敵は彼が来ると知っていても、誰も立ち向かえなかった。

entries.english: The midnight-hued steel circlet of the sorceress-queen Berúthiel.  It grants extraordinary powers of sight and awareness at a terrible physical cost.
entries.japanese: 魔女の女王ベルーシエルの、真夜中色の鋼のサークレット。肉体に恐ろしい代償を払わせるかわりに、視力と知覚に並外れた力を授ける。

entries.english: From dying Númenor, Elendil brought this shining winged circlet, emblem of Gondor through an age of the world.
entries.japanese: 滅びゆくヌーメノールから、エレンディルが持ち出した輝く翼のサークレット。世界の一時代を通じたゴンドールの象徴。

entries.english: A massive golden crown, set with wondrous jewels of thought and warding, once worn by the kings of ancient Númenor.
entries.japanese: 古のヌーメノールの王たちがかぶった巨大な黄金の冠。思考と守護の不思議な宝石がはめ込まれている。

entries.english: Familiar with the secret ways hidden in darkness, this leather cuirass is truly more than it appears.
entries.japanese: 闇に隠れた秘密の道を知るこの革の胸当ては、見た目以上の力を持っている。

entries.english: In this studded cuirass of pliable leather lives the memory of unvanquished Himring, defiant fortress surrounded by the legions of Morgoth.
entries.japanese: 柔らかな革に鋲を打ったこの胸当てには、モルゴスの軍勢に囲まれながら屈しなかった砦ヒムリングの記憶が生きている。

entries.english: An amazingly light tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather.  Those who wear it move with agility and assurance.
entries.japanese: 硬い革の厚い鱗を重ねて縫った、驚くほど軽い上衣と裾。身につける者は敏捷かつ確かに動く。

entries.english: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, well padded with leather.  You feel as strong and tall as Arvedui, last king of Arnor, as you put it on.
entries.japanese: 絡み合う鋼の輪で作った上衣、脚覆い、袖。革の詰め物が十分に入っている。着ると、アルノール最後の王アルヴェドゥイのように強く長身になった気がする。

entries.english: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain.  Magics to enhance body and mind lie within, and no door can bar the wearer's path.
entries.japanese: 絡み合う鋼の輪で作った上衣、脚覆い、袖。急所は第二の鎖の層で補強してある。肉体と精神を高める魔法が宿り、どんな扉も着用者の道を阻めない。

entries.english: Small steel plates cover an inner layer of sturdy canvas, and both metal and cloth bear scenes of hunting and war.  As you don the armour of Eorl the Young, matchless in combat, you feel his spirit surround you.
entries.japanese: 丈夫な帆布の内張りを小さな鋼板が覆い、金属にも布にも狩猟と戦の場面が描かれている。戦で比類のない若きエオルの鎧を着ると、彼の魂に包まれるのを感じる。

entries.english: A gleaming steel suit covering the wearer from neck to foot, with runes of warding and stability deeply engraved into its surface.
entries.japanese: 首から足まで着用者を覆う、輝く鋼の鎧。表面には守護と安定のルーンが深く刻まれている。

entries.english: This wondrous shirt of fine-linked chain shimmers before your eyes like light upon a rippling sea, the gems on it glittering like stars, the sound of the rings when shaken like the tinkle of rain in a pool.  It stands untouched amidst the fury of the elements, and blows seem strangely less powerful.
entries.japanese: 細かい鎖の輪でできた不思議な胴衣。波立つ海の光のように揺らめき、宝石は星のように光り、輪を揺らすと水面に降る雨のような音を立てる。元素の猛威の中でも損なわれず、打撃は不思議と弱くなる。

entries.english: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend.  It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it, and mighty are its powers to protect and banish.
entries.japanese: 伝説のドワーフの鍛冶師が遥か昔に鍛えた、真の銀の輝く鎧。見つめると純白に光り、守護と追放の強大な力を持つ。

entries.english: A suit of imperishable adamant with unconquerable strength to endure evil and disruptive magics.  It protects the life force of its wearer as nothing else can.
entries.japanese: 不滅の金剛石の鎧。邪悪と魔法の干渉に耐える不屈の強さを持ち、ほかの何にもできないほど、着用者の生命力を守る。

entries.english: A cape worn by a hero from Valinor, a land utterly beyond the strife of Elements.
entries.japanese: 元素の争いから完全に隔たった地、ヴァリノールの英雄がまとったケープ。

entries.english: This elven-grey mantle possesses great powers of tranquility and concealment, and grants the wearer the knowledge and understanding of the Sindar.
entries.japanese: 静けさと隠蔽の大きな力を持つ、エルフの灰色のマント。着用者にシンダールの知識と理解を授ける。

entries.english: A translucent cloak of pearly grey with glowing, energized Elven runes showing calm and clear as moonlight on still water.
entries.japanese: 真珠灰色の半透明のクローク。力を帯びたエルフのルーンが、静かな水面の月光のように穏やかで澄んで輝く。

entries.english: This shimmering cloak of greens and browns was once worn by the young Aragorn, a keen-eyed captain of Rohan and Gondor, valiant on both land and sea.
entries.japanese: かつて若きアラゴルンがまとった、緑と茶に揺らめくクローク。彼は鋭い目を持つローハンとゴンドールの隊長で、陸でも海でも勇敢だった。

entries.english: A crystal-blue cape of fine silk worn by a silent messenger of the forces of Law.  Seldom will its wearer be diverted from his mission.
entries.japanese: 秩序の力の寡黙な使者がまとった、上質な絹の水晶青のケープ。着用者が使命から逸れることは滅多にない。

entries.english: The opaque midnight folds of this cloak, inlaid with a multitude of tiny diamonds, swirl around you, and you feel a hint, a fragment of the restorative magics of Lúthien, the most beautiful being who ever knew death.
entries.japanese: 無数の小さなダイヤを象嵌した、不透明な真夜中のひだが周囲を渦巻く。死を知った最も美しい存在、ルーシエンの回復の魔法の気配、そのかけらを感じる。

entries.english: The great cloak given to Tuor by the Dweller in the Deep.  As you wrap yourself from head to foot the words of Ulmo echo: "Thus thou shalt walk under my shadow".
entries.japanese: 深みに住む者がトゥオルへ与えた大きなクローク。頭から足まで包むと、ウルモの言葉が響く。『こうして、おまえは私の影の下を歩むであろう。』

entries.english: A hero's handgear that lends great prowess in battle.
entries.japanese: 戦で大きな力を授ける、英雄の手の装備。

entries.english: These gloves glow so brightly as to light the way for the wearer and cast magical bolts with great frequency.
entries.japanese: 持ち主の道を照らすほど明るく光り、魔法のボルトを頻繁に放つ手袋。

entries.english: A set of gauntlets that smoulder with an unnatural heat.
entries.japanese: 不自然な熱を帯びてくすぶる籠手。

entries.english: A set of handgear, freezing with unnatural cold.
entries.japanese: 不自然な冷気で凍てつく手の装備。

entries.english: A set of handgear with sparks that crackle across its knuckleguards.
entries.japanese: 拳の防護部を火花がはぜながら走る手の装備。

entries.english: A set of gauntlets that give off a foul, acrid odour yet remain untarnished.
entries.japanese: 鼻を刺す悪臭を放ちながらも、曇らない籠手。

entries.english: A pair of weakening gauntlets, named after Beren, who returned to Thingol having lost to Carcharoth the hand that clasped a Silmaril.
entries.japanese: 着用者を弱らせる籠手。シルマリルを握った手をカルハロスに奪われ、シンゴルのもとへ戻ったベレンにちなんだ名を持つ。

entries.english: The iron-shod gauntlets of the Dark Elven smith Eöl, who imbued them with magics he could channel in battle.
entries.japanese: 暗闇のエルフの鍛冶師エオルの、鉄で補強した籠手。彼は戦で使える魔法をこれに込めた。

entries.english: Your {kind} grow{s} magical spikes...
entries.japanese: あなたの{kind}に魔法の棘が生える{s}……

entries.english: The hand-sheathing of Fingolfin, the Elven warrior-king, who dealt Morgoth seven mighty wounds and pain that will last until the end of Arda.
entries.japanese: モルゴスに七つの深い傷と、アルダの終わりまで続く痛みを与えた、エルフの戦士王フィンゴルフィンの手を包んだ装備。

entries.english: The shield of Elros Tar-Minyatur, founder of Númenor.  Granted long life by the Valar, even his shield became imbued with power.
entries.japanese: ヌーメノールを建国したエルロス・タル＝ミンヤトゥアの盾。ヴァラールから長寿を授かった彼の盾にまで、力が染み込んだ。

entries.english: Invoking the strength and endurance of Thorin, King under the Mountain, this little metal shield is proof against the Element of Earth.
entries.japanese: 山の下の王トーリンの強さと忍耐を呼ぶ、小さな金属の盾。大地の元素を防ぐ。

entries.english: This shield emblazoned with a multitude of creatures unseen for ages once protected Celegorm, Lord of Himlad; around it, a mystic balance lies, containing the conflicts of the elements.
entries.japanese: 長い時代見られなくなった多くの生き物を描いた盾。かつてヒムラドの領主ケレゴルムを守った。周囲には神秘の均衡があり、元素の争いを抑えている。

entries.english: The painted shield of a chieftain of Far Harad, gaudy and barbaric.  Its wielder will fear nothing and fight with unnatural strength, but also draw attention to himself.
entries.japanese: 遠いハラドの首長の、派手で野蛮な絵入りの盾。持ち主は何も恐れず、超自然的な強さで戦うが、人目も引く。

entries.english: The great metal-bound shield of Elendil's younger son Anárion, whom even Sauron could not corrupt.
entries.japanese: サウロンでさえ堕落させられなかった、エレンディルの次男アナーリオンの、金属で補強した大盾。

entries.english: Your {kind} throbs deep blue...
entries.japanese: あなたの{kind}が深い青で脈打つ……

entries.english: A shining shield wrought for Eärendil Half-Elven, son of Tuor and Idril, "scored with runes to keep all wounds and harm from him".
entries.japanese: トゥオルとイドリルの息子、半エルフのエアレンディルのために作られた輝く盾。『あらゆる傷と害から彼を守るルーンが刻まれた』品。

entries.english: The legendary shield of Ereinion Gil-galad, who fought his way to the gates of the Dark Tower, and with whom came light even to Gorgoroth.
entries.japanese: 暗黒の塔の門まで戦い抜いたエレイニオン・ギル＝ガラドの伝説的な盾。彼とともに、ゴルゴロスにさえ光が訪れた。

entries.english: Twinned serpents with eyes of emerald meet beneath a crown of flowers to form this ring, an ancient treasure of Isildur's house.
entries.japanese: エメラルドの目を持つ二匹の蛇が、花の冠の下で向かい合ってこの指輪を形作る。イシルドゥアの家の古い宝。

entries.english: The treasure of Tulkas, most fleet and wrathful of the Valar.
entries.japanese: ヴァラールで最も足が速く、怒りに強いトゥルカスの宝。

entries.english: {name} glows deep red...
entries.japanese: {name}が深い赤に輝く……

entries.english: The Ring of Fire, made of gold and set with a ruby that glows like flame.  Narya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
entries.japanese: 火の指輪。黄金で作られ、炎のように光るルビーをはめている。ナルヤはケレブリンボールが作り、エルフがサウロンから隠した三つの力の指輪の一つ。

entries.english: {name} glows bright white...
entries.japanese: {name}が明るい白に輝く……

entries.english: The Ring of Adamant, made of mithril with a pure white stone as centerpiece.  Nenya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
entries.japanese: 金剛石の指輪。ミスリルで作られ、中央に純白の石がある。ネンヤはケレブリンボールが作り、エルフがサウロンから隠した三つの力の指輪の一つ。

entries.english: {name} glows deep blue...
entries.japanese: {name}が深い青色に輝く...

entries.english: The Ring of Sapphire, made of gold with a brilliant blue gem that shines like stars.  It glitters untouchable despite all that Morgoth ever wrought.  Vilya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
entries.japanese: サファイアの指輪。黄金で作られ、星のように光る鮮やかな青い宝石を持つ。モルゴスが成したあらゆることにも損なわれずに輝く。ヴィルヤはケレブリンボールが作り、エルフがサウロンから隠した三つの力の指輪の一つ。

entries.english: "One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them, One Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them."  Made of massive gold, and inscribed with hidden runes in the foul speech of Mordor, Isildur's Bane possesses powers so great that it inevitably twists and masters any mortal being who wears it.
entries.japanese: 『一つの指輪はすべてを統べ、一つの指輪はすべてを見つけ、一つの指輪はすべてを連れてきて、闇の中で繋ぎとめる。』重厚な黄金ででき、モルドールの忌まわしい言葉による隠されたルーンが刻まれている。『イシルドゥアの禍』はあまりに強大な力を持ち、身につけるいかなる定命の者をも、必ず歪めて支配する。

entries.english: A fiery circle of bronze, with mighty spells to ward off and banish evil.
entries.japanese: 強大な邪悪防護と追放の呪文を備えた、炎のような青銅の輪。

entries.english: The ancient heirloom of Ingwë, high lord of the Vanyar, against whom nothing of evil could stand.
entries.japanese: ヴァンヤールの上級王イングウェの古い家宝。いかなる邪悪も彼に立ち向かえなかった。

entries.english: The Nauglamír, a carcanet of gold set with a multitude of shining gems of Valinor.  The radiant Silmaril of Fëanor hangs in its midst as its crowning glory.  The sturdy spirits of Dwarvish craftsmen who labored long in mountain smithies lie within it still, and as gossamer it rests upon the bearer.
entries.japanese: ヴァリノールの輝く宝石を無数にはめた黄金の首飾り、ナウグラミア。その中央には、最高の栄光としてフェアノールの輝くシルマリルが下がる。山の鍛冶場で長く働いたドワーフ職人たちの頑丈な魂が今も宿るが、身につけると蜘蛛の糸のように軽い。

entries.english: A green stone, imbued with the power of Elvendom and the light of the Sun.  Those who gaze through it see the aged and infirm as young again, and its wearer brings healing after victory in battle.
entries.japanese: エルフの国の力と太陽の光を宿した緑の石。これを通して見ると老いて弱った者も再び若く見え、身につけた者は戦の勝利の後に癒しをもたらす。

entries.english: A plain white jewel, given by Queen Arwen to Frodo Baggins before his return to the Shire.
entries.japanese: フロド・バギンズがホビット庄へ帰る前に、王妃アルウェンが与えた飾り気のない白い宝石。

entries.english: A massive suit of heavy dragon scales deeply saturated with many colors.  It throbs with angry energies, and you feel the raw elemental might of untamed Lightning as you put it on.
entries.japanese: 重い竜の鱗でできた巨大な鎧。多くの色が深く染み込んでいる。怒りの力が脈打ち、身につけると荒々しく制御されぬ稲妻の元素の力を感じる。

entries.english: A great suit of dragon hide, set with scales of many hues.  Even the mightiest wyrms of Law and Chaos fear the judgement of its wearer.
entries.japanese: さまざまな色の鱗をはめた、竜の皮の大鎧。秩序と混沌の最強の古竜でさえ、着用者の裁きを恐れる。

entries.english: An adamant suit with scales of every color.  Untrammelled powers elemental and ethereal swirl around it in an inextricably intermingled nimbus.
entries.japanese: あらゆる色の鱗を持つ金剛石の鎧。束縛されぬ元素と霊的な力が、分かちがたく混ざり合った光輪となって周囲を渦巻く。

entries.english: The mighty Hammer of the Underworld, blackened by doomspells of shattering.  Its wielder holds the lives of all Morgoth's servants in his hand.
entries.japanese: 破砕の滅びの呪文で黒ずんだ、強大な冥界の槌。その使い手は、モルゴスのすべての従僕の命を手中に握る。

entries.english: Containing much of the power of he who once was mightiest among the Ainur, this plain iron crown has mounted upon it the two remaining Silmarils, greatest treasures of Middle-Earth.
entries.japanese: かつてアイヌアで最強だった者の力の多くを秘める、飾り気のない鉄の冠。中つ国最高の宝である、残る二つのシルマリルが取り付けられている。
